senses.gloss: अञ्ज् vt. 7P (pp. अक्त) 1. To anoint; 2. to decorate; 3. to glorify, to celebrate; 4. to distinguish; 5. to go, to approach.With अभि-, 1. to anoint; 2. to pollute.With अभिवि-, to reveal, to make manifest.With आ-, 1. to anoint; 2. to extol.With वि-, to manifest, to reveal, व्यनक्ति लोकत्रितयेऽपि योग्यताम् Sis.i.26.
अञ्जन (I) m. Name of the elephant presiding over the west or south-west quarter.

अञ्जन (II) n. 1. Act of applying an ointment; 2. black pigment applied to the eyelashes, द्यौरञ्जनकालीभिर्जलदालीभिस्तथावव्रे R.G., R.vii.8, वर्षतीवाञ्जनं नभः Mrich.i.; 3. ointment; 4. ink; 5. night; 6. a suggested meaning (in rhetoric), See व्यञ्जन; 7. the process by which it is suggested (in rhetoric), अन्यार्थाधीकृद्व्यापृंतिरञ्जनम् K.Pr.ii.
अञ्जना f. 1. Name of Hanūmat’s mother; 2. the process by which a suggested meaning is got at (See अञ्जन 7).
आञ्जन (I) n. 1. Ointment for the eyes; 2. fat.
आञ्जन (II) m. An epithet of Hanūmat, दाशरथिबलैरिवाञ्जननीलनलपरिगतप्रान्तैः Kad.
अञ्जन-शलाका f. a stick for the application of collyrium, ज्ञानाञ्जनशलाकया Sik.

अञ्जलि m. 1. The open hands placed side by side and slightly hollowed, श्रवणाञ्जलिपुटपेयं विरचितवान् भारताख्यममृतं यः Ve.i. (hence) a mode of supplication when such hands are raised to the forehead, e.g. अञ्जलिं बद्ध्वा; 2. a libation; 3. a measure sufficient to fill both hands when placed side by side, प्रकीर्णः पुष्पाणां हरिचरणयोरञ्जलिरयम् Ve.i.
अञ्जलि-कर्मन् n. making the anjali or respectful salutation.
अञ्जलि-कारिका f. a doll or puppet made of clay.
अञ्जलि-पुट m.n. cavity produced in making the anjali.
अञ्जलि-बन्ध m. salutation with the anjali raised to the forehead.
अञ्जलि-बन्धन n. salutation with the anjali raised to the forehead.
अञ्जलिका f. A small mouse.
अञ्जस a. (f. सी) Straight, upright.
अञ्जसा ind. 1. Truly, in the proper light, R.xix.31; 2. straight; 3. soon, instantly.
अञ्जस a. (f. सी) Straight, upright.
अञ्जिष्ठ m. The sun.
आञ्जनी f. Ointment for the eyes.
आञ्जनी-कारी f. a woman who annoints or makes ointments.
आञ्जनेय m. A name of Hanūmat.
